roadmap.title: Pin source, active engine and ownership
roadmap.description: Review current START_HERE, branch/HEAD, matching authority and accepted assets; preserve owner work.

roadmap.title: Run one bounded coding MoE trial
roadmap.description: Install and select the exact reviewed model through the normal model pool only when the runtime and budget are ready. Use one scoped coding task, at most 8192 context and 1024 output tokens, and independent tests. Record actual memory, elapsed time and result.

roadmap.title: Reopen and verify the portable Route Lab
roadmap.description: Verify the original Blender scene, GLB digest, dimensions, axes, spawn coordinates and CPU preview. Keep authored maps and production assets unchanged.

roadmap.title: Integrate an isolated Mandala gameplay slice
roadmap.description: Follow the existing atlas next gate: dry routes, selected collision, held interaction, interrupt/reset/side-swap and authoritative event order. Keep folds closed. A prepared roadmap is not an executed integration.

roadmap.title: Import the exact Route Lab into a separate Unreal experiment
roadmap.description: Use an owner-selected existing .uproject and installed engine. Verify scale and materials, then deliberately configure collision/navigation and capture actual engine evidence.

roadmap.title: Review actual geometry and engine outcomes
roadmap.description: Reopen exact exports; distinguish stored geometry evidence, new engine tests and missing hardware/player gates. The two rendered-client qualification remains open until actually tested.

roadmap.title: Publish the reviewed development source
roadmap.description: Return exact source commits, artifact digests, checks and limits. Push the scoped development branch when authorized; release publication is a separate action.

roadmap.title: Review Yuga device placement
roadmap.description: Run the read-only editor plan on the actual extension hosts, distinguish observed devices from runtime selection, verify host identities, budget and fallback. Do not rent or run automatically.

roadmap.title: Evaluate models offline on held-out Yuga tasks
roadmap.description: Compare one pinned baseline and reviewed candidate on identical inputs; scores are blocked until local rights, measured device, structured outputs and repeatable same-engine tests are documented.

roadmap.title: Record asset source and rights before import
roadmap.description: Collect the source revision, terms, notices and derived-asset identifiers; generated meshes remain concept-only until rebuilt and independently validated.

roadmap.title: Cross-check route boundaries and keyboard focus
roadmap.description: Run exact Godot and browser gates on pinned sources; preserve production authority and keep Unreal import validation separate from playable evidence.

roadmap.title: Measure browser scene budgets
roadmap.description: Profile a deliberately isolated PlayCanvas scene for draw calls, texture footprint, and first interaction; do not migrate gameplay authority to the renderer.

roadmap.title: Commission the authored Monsoon Exchange geometry
roadmap.description: Use the pinned survey and independent Blender/GLB checks to stage exactly ten pads, two rite disks and seven thresholds with runtime collision, scale, and clearance tests. Never use reference map files as production assets.

roadmap.title: Validate Ember Rite recipient-scoped cues
roadmap.description: First replay solo Chromium audio and Rust ritual checks, then collect eligible and ineligible listener receipts, reconnect lifecycle and device listening observations in an authorized test. Solo or unit results do not prove online Ember Rite.

roadmap.title: Qualify the ten-seat side-swapped Monsoon retake
roadmap.description: After the Mandala integration control and the Monsoon runtime gates, test two teams of five: opening, interrupted rite, legal cross-site return, reconnect and retake. Keep the experimental map out of production matches until accepted.
